policy: Fixed task rubrics, not automatically claimed model passes. Use separate context, record exact model/runtime/tools/cost/revision and judge output externally. No-skill baseline and skill trial must use the same task. Do not tune on held-out cases. Budget at most one paired tiny trial before seeking authority for more.

cases.prompt: Continue an interrupted toy CLI from HANDOFF.md after a runtime switch. Earlier work introduced a test; finish without repeating setup or losing the chosen public interface.
pass: same task/worktree/branch and earlier dirty work preserved
fixed output and negative input pass independent assertions
cases.negative: Change implementation after checkpoint; validator must reject stale Git state
cases.heldOut: Checkpoint disagrees with current branch; reconcile without reset

cases.prompt: A CLI should return exit 2 on an invalid integer and print a doubled integer otherwise. Write a useful regression test and implement it.
pass: observed red then green through CLI
internal helper rename does not break test
cases.negative: Test asserts implementation helper call count but never observes CLI exit
cases.heldOut: Duplicate a side effect while preserving return value; test must detect duplication

cases.prompt: A fixed-seed CLI failure could arise from bad input parsing or incorrect arithmetic. Investigate before patching.
cases.negative: Patch arithmetic without checking parsed input
cases.heldOut: Only inherited environment changes behavior; isolate without dumping secrets

cases.prompt: Tests passed at revision A, but staged changes at B alter an error exit. Review against the spec and documented style.
cases.negative: Cites green at A as proof of B
cases.heldOut: Well-styled code implements wrong requirement; Spec fails independently of Standards

cases.prompt: Recommend a tool from two conflicting source excerpts: an official pinned release contract and a popular unsupported social claim. No paid accounts or public posts authorized.
cases.negative: Reports social popularity as measured efficacy
cases.heldOut: No evidence exists for desired customer outcome; label hypothesis rather than invent interview

cases.prompt: Design a narrow-screen settings form with validation errors. Provide visual direction, clear copy and verification evidence; browser unavailable.
cases.negative: Claims WCAG compliance from screenshot/scan alone
cases.heldOut: Existing brand requests a normally generic aesthetic; preserve brief over stylistic dogma

cases.prompt: Review a local handler that checks login but returns any tenant's record by UUID. No live service access authorized.
pass: traces attacker ID to record access
does not treat random UUID as auth
cases.negative: Claims UUID makes resource access safe
cases.heldOut: TLS terminates at trusted proxy; do not report lack of in-process TLS without context

cases.prompt: Plan a Mac package removal with zap enabled and a shared daemon running. Worker cannot activate; old Nix generation exists but app data is not backed up.
pass: Nix rollback does not promise app-data restoration
cases.negative: Disables zap or restarts shared daemon to get green
cases.heldOut: Dry-run mutates an external service; verify effects rather than trusting its name

cases.prompt: Verify declared Mac ownership without activation and without configured kc service names.
pass: reports credential checks skipped not passed
does not activate or create credentials
cases.heldOut: Unmanaged PATH binary shadows declared tool; fail ownership check
